features.name: Question Panel

features.evidence: Carried over from P1 -- verified working

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: Carried over from P1 -- verified working

features.name: Document Import
features.description: Users can import .txt and .md files via ImportPanel with file picker
features.evidence: ImportPanel resolves the picked file with documents.pathForFile, rejects other extensions and files over 10 MB in the panel, and calls documents.import. DocumentService keeps metadata and text in memory. tests/document-service.test.ts covers import, rejection, and no documents-meta.json write.

features.name: Document Detail with Content
features.description: DocumentDetail shows full document content, metadata, and delete button
features.evidence: View Content calls documents.getContent over documents:get-content and renders the text in a scrollable pre-wrap container. The detail view shows title, filename, size, import date, and status, and Delete removes the in-memory document.

features.name: Basic Persistence
features.description: Imported documents persist across app restarts via filesystem storage
features.evidence: DocumentService writes documents/<filename>, content/<id>.txt, and documents-meta.json on import, and deletes those files plus chunks and the index-meta entry on delete. A new DocumentService reading the same data directory reloads the library. App calls refreshDocuments() on mount. tests/document-service.test.ts covers import, reload, rejection, and delete.
